text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Lala! That cooling sheet you had Blast 
give me yesterday worked wonders!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
My flushed body cooled right down, and I 
slept way better than usual.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
You looked a bit wobblier than usual, 
after all. I'm just glad to see you're 
feelin' better.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
It's great to pour your heart into 
training, but don't go pushing yourself 
till you collapse, alright?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you. ...Fufu, you went all the 
way to the pharmacy to buy this for me, 
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh, dear. And here I told Blast-san to 
keep quiet about it.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I want Ai-san to stay full of energy, ya 
know. Need her shinin' so bright it's 
blindin', or else—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Our mock race together is coming up soon, 
after all... right?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Right. Then, as you wish, I shall take 
you on in peak condition."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: We're going all out next time too, Lala!
